summary: Tunceli stands under the national framework of Turkey; no trans-specific statute, enforcement pattern, institution or documented incident specific to the province appears in the source inventory, so the national assessment applies, and the absence is recorded as absence of documented divergence rather than as evidence of local permissiveness.
tangentialFactors: The two sources available for Tunceli are country-wide documents: a legislative draft reported by Human Rights Watch on 29 October 2025 and Kaos GL's 2025 human-rights monitoring report. Neither provides a provincial breakdown, and neither records anything specific to Tunceli or to its neighbouring provinces. Nothing in the inventory distinguishes Tunceli from the national position in either direction.
localsOnly: No Tunceli-specific provision, practice or institution affecting trans residents was identified in the sources. Resident-facing rules in the province are those of the national framework.
outOfScopeNotes: The enactment status of the national legislative draft that the sources describe is unresolved. No Tunceli-level data was located on detentions, prosecutions, custody conditions, healthcare access or protection machinery, so no assessment beyond the national one can be made for the province.
